Genie controls Finder, Music, Notes and other apps on your behalf to arrange windows, send notes, and run the automations you trigger from the menu bar.
Genie uses the camera to capture instant vintage Polaroid memos and photo notes.
Genie organises and previews the files on your Desktop for its spatial desktop grid.
Genie opens and organises documents you browse through its file workspace.
Genie reads your Downloads folder so recently downloaded files appear in its workspace.

Genie accesses the microphone to listen for Hey Genie, voice typing, and hands-free desktop actions.
Genie shows files on network volumes and shared folders inside its file workspace.
Genie shows files on connected drives inside its file workspace.
Genie uses speech recognition to decode your spoken words directly into chat messages and trigger voice commands.
